title: Compatibility with Accu-Chek Aviva Connect
symptom: Unable to transfer glucose readings from an Accu-Chek Aviva Connect via Bluetooth. The meter pairs successfully, but the on/off slider in settings -> glucose meters -> use bluetooth meter cannot be toggled to 'on'. After pairing, no data transfer happens and the meter times out.
fix: The thread suggests that after disabling auto-send, performing My Data-> Data Transfer->Wireless allows the meter to talk to xDrip. Re-enabling auto-send then allows transfer after each reading.
evidence_quote: Same meter, I finally managed to get it to talk to xDrip by doing My Data-> Data Transfer->Wireless, after __disabling__ auto-send. Since then I reenabled auto-send and the transfer happens after I take each reading.
